name: MKT_EM_EVENTS
description: This table is used for tracking marketing events. Events are a mechanism for the marketeer to get in touch with existing contacts and prospects and present relevant and highly focussed content.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Event ID : Primary Key of this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Event Number - Alternate key of this table.

columns.name: EVENT_NAME
columns.description: Formal name of the event that will be published externally.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description - more details about the marketing event

columns.name: EVENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Event category. This field will be primarily used for reporting purposes indicating the type of event.

columns.name: VENUE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the venue where this event is hosted

columns.name: EVT_START_DATE
columns.description: Date for start of the marketing event

columns.name: EVT_END_DATE
columns.description: Date of end of the marketing event

columns.name: EVT_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Event status - indicates the current status of the marketing event e.g planning  v/s scheduled etc)

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE_ID
columns.description: Source Code Id. Foreign key to MKT_SC_SOURCE_CODES table.
